response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile is almost entirely web/backend (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than C++ on Windows. Hands-on C++ is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5-10 years. There is no fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience, and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle work (only MySQL/MongoDB/generic SQL). Despite strong engineering fundamentals, communication skills, and CI/CD exposure, the core mandatory requirements are unmet.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, senior-level engineering experience with strong testing/TDD and CI/CD practices
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Excellent communication demonstrated through workshops, conference talks, and teaching
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago, and not Windows-centric
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; databases are MongoDB/MySQL
